high_level_description: A clean, high-resolution 1600x900 landscape structural layout featuring five isolated, vividly colored objects on a pale neutral background: a red tennis ball, a green garden hose with gray nozzle, a detailed bicycle with wicker basket holding wilted daisies, an ivy-covered pickup truck showing its front hood, and a symmetrical quadcopter drone.

style_description.lighting: Flat, even studio lighting with no shadows

compositional_deconstruction.background: Uniform pale neutral background (#f8f8f8), no texture or gradient

elements.desc: Red tennis ball: solid circle, centered at (200,450), diameter 180px
Green garden hose with gray nozzle: sinuous green polyline (S-curve) ending in small gray rectangle (nozzle), horizontally centered at (480,450)

Bicycle with front wicker basket containing visibly wilted daisies: black frame, black wheels, light-brown rounded-rect basket, and 4 small white daisy heads with green stem lines, centered at (760,450)
Ivy-covered pickup truck front hood: gray trapezoidal hood with black grille and headlights, overlaid with 4 small dark-green leaf-shaped polygons representing ivy, centered at (1040,450)
Drone: central dark-gray square body with four thin gray arms extending diagonally, each ending in a small white rotor circle, centered at (1320,450)
